name: Spring-Loaded Panel (CR 2)
body:
Spring-Loaded Panel
CR 2

XP 600

Type mechanical; Perception DC 22; Disable Device DC 22

EFFECTS

Trigger touch; Reset manual

Effect panel flips up and knocks one victim off the bridge into the sinkhole (Reflex DC 15 avoids; 30 foot fall, 3d6 damage)
